# Connectors {#mcp background-color="#f0674d"}

Your email, calendar and files, in the same conversation.

## What MCP is

```{=html}
{{< include images/mcp-plug.svg >}}
```

**MCP** is a standard plug. A **connector** is one plug: the agent then uses your
email, calendar or files the same way it uses your folder.

## Switch it on

1. Go to `claude.ai/customize/connectors`. Pick **Gmail**, **Google Calendar** or
   **Google Drive** → **Connect**. Log in with Google and approve.
2. Start a new Claude Code session and type `/mcp`. It's in the list.

[Codex supports MCP too. Ask it how to connect yours.]{.small .muted}

## Email

::: {.prompt}
Find all my emails from [name] this month. One line each: date, subject, what they
want.
:::

::: {.prompt}
Draft a reply. Show it to me before you send it.
:::

## Calendar

::: {.prompt}
What does my week look like? Find two free hours for writing, and put them in my
calendar.
:::

## Drive

::: {.prompt}
Find the referee report on [paper] in my Google Drive, and draft a response plan,
point by point.
:::
